message.content: In the conversation, LiHua is the one who asks Emily Burnett if she has read the The Lord of the Rings novels. LiHua expresses curiosity about how the novels tie into the series "The Rings of Power" and invites Emily to share her thoughts on the series. LiHua mentions that he is currently enjoying "The Rings of Power" and appreciates how it explores the lore, and he specifically asks if Emily has read the novels, as he believes the background material could be beneficial for understanding the series.
